name: The round
summary: A children's ballet school built on the Royal Albert Hall's one shape. The stage sits inside a great circle that runs off the page, and the school's year (terms, half terms, shows, exams) is set round it like the frieze round the Hall, still. Beside it the question every parent has: tap your child's age and the class, day, time and length appear, with a trial request ready. Every photograph is a circle; children only from behind or far away on a stage. Ivory ground, ink words, one colour from a horse chestnut fresh out of its shell. Hahmlet alone, hairline against heavy. For dance and ballet schools.
